ideas.title: The Impact of Fraud on Minnesota's Social Programs
ideas.description: An investigation into the prevalence and impact of fraud on Minnesota's social programs, including the Feeding Our Future program
ideas.angle: The human and financial costs of fraud on social programs
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota's social programs?
How does fraud impact the effectiveness of these programs?
ideas.insight: This story would shed light on the issue of fraud in Minnesota's social programs and highlight the need for improved oversight and controls.

ideas.title: The Legacy of Robert Mueller's Investigation
ideas.description: An examination of the lasting impact of Robert Mueller's investigation into Russia-Trump campaign ties
questions: What were the key findings of the Mueller investigation?
How did the investigation impact American politics?
ideas.insight: This story would provide a comprehensive analysis of the Mueller investigation's legacy and its ongoing influence on American politics.
